brief:
An Israeli military vehicle overturned in the village of Kafr Ni'ma, located west of Ramallah in the occupied West Bank, Eye on Palestine reported. The incident marked another occurrence involving Israeli military transport in the densely populated Palestinian territory.

The circumstances surrounding the overturn remained unclear. No immediate reports indicated casualties or the specific cause of the vehicle's loss of control. Israeli military operations in areas west of Ramallah have been a recurring feature of Palestinian-Israeli tensions in the region.
